findings.title: Microsoft Security Update Guide - CVE-2026-80097
findings.summary_md: Microsoft released the advisory on 8 September 2026, classifying CVE-2026-80097 as an elevation-of-privilege vulnerability in Microsoft Authenticator for Android with a CVSS 8.6 score mapped to CWE-287. The update notes the fix was released and later updated on 15 September 2026. This is the vendor's official confirmation of the flaw.

findings.title: Enclave: AuthMask - Original Research Disclosure
findings.summary_md: Researcher Ofek Levin from Enclave disclosed the original finding: an exported activity `com.microsoft.identity.client.AccountChooserActivity` in Authenticator allowed any unprivileged Android app to impersonate a Microsoft first-party app and receive tokens. The blog explains the broker validation bypass and confirms Microsoft patched it as CVE-2026-80097. The disclosure is dated 23 October 2026.
